title: MALFORMED Entity reference — targetEntity 'widget-1' does not match the entityName grammar
why: targetEntity is 'widget-1' — lowercase initial and a hyphen — which cannot be the name of any declared entity, because entity.name is constrained to PascalCase by $defs/entityName. A malformed reference can never resolve, so it must fail closed rather than be tolerated, normalised, or case-folded into a match. Silent normalisation is how 'widget-1' becomes 'Widget' and an unowned entity acquires an ownership relation it never declared.
notes: SCHEMA-DECIDABLE. Both entity.name and action.targetEntity reference the single $defs/entityName definition, so the declaring form and the referencing form share one grammar and cannot drift apart. Rejection comes from the pattern '^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*$' and needs no cross-array join. A schema failure here is a real schema failure and should be reported as one.
